_note: Cloud capability spectrum for the 2026-08-11 board: three Google and three
OpenAI models chosen to span weak -> strong rather than to cluster at the top.
The frontier suites saturate for capable models (ds4 41/41, and on 2026-08-10
gemini-3.5-flash also took 41/41), so picking three flagships each would have
produced six indistinguishable rows. Each vendor therefore gets a floor, a
middle, and a current top.
GOOGLE  gemini-2.5-flash-lite   floor. Measured 27/41 on 2026-08-10 (14/15,
7/14, 6/12), so it is a known-discriminating
anchor and ties this board to that one.
gemini-3.5-flash-lite   middle. Newer lite tier, not previously run.
gemini-3.6-flash        top. Newest flash generation, not previously
run -- the row most likely to be new signal.
OPENAI  gpt-5-nano              floor. Smallest of the oldest 5.x generation.
gpt-5.4-mini           middle.
gpt-5.6-terra          top. Newest generation available.
CREDENTIALS. Both vendors use api_key_env, never an inline key, so this file
is safe to commit -- unlike destinations.gemini_lowtier.json and
destinations.openai_lowmid.json, which carry inline keys and are covered by
the destinations.*.json gitignore. run_cloud_spectrum.sh exports both vars by
reading those existing files, so the secrets never reach argv or git.
temperature = -1 on the OpenAI entries means 'do not send temperature'. The
gpt-5.x reasoning models reject the field outright; this is the July 29
board's proven convention, not a magic number. The Gemini entries go through
openai_chat_completions where temperature is accepted.
max_output_tokens = 32000 everywhere. The 2026-08-10 board's most expensive
lesson was that the old Gemini configs sat at 3000 and truncation scores as a
model failure; it used 16000. These suites want 50-90 lines of Aether plus
reasoning, and on the OpenAI Responses API the budget also has to cover
reasoning tokens, which are invisible in the answer. Generous on purpose.
Cloud lanes are rate-limit bound rather than memory bound, so cooldown and
backoff matter where they did not for the local board. These are the July 29
values, which survived a 10-model sweep.
